{
  "$schema": "https://anthropic.com/claude-code/plugin.schema.json",
  "name": "acceptance-progress",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "A mod that shows the progress of the issue you are working on: when the agent reads or edits a GitHub issue with gh, it reads the issue's checklists (- [ ] / - [x]) back from GitHub and shows how many acceptance criteria are done and which remain.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Seiya Kawamura"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/insession-space/claude-ship",
  "repository": "https://github.com/insession-space/claude-ship",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "github",
    "issue",
    "acceptance-criteria",
    "checklist",
    "ui"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
